searchText: AIUI, we do *not* want the base fee to go to 0 because it can't go back up below 7. <@!574864862338088960> can confirm, though! Agreed if that's the case, we should remove it from the EIP 👍 This was fixed a long time ago. It can recover from 0 now. Right now (per spec) the base fee cannot go to zero, basically by accident. It *also* can recover from going to 0.
